structure.unit: Professions and Occupations Regulated by Boards Within the Department of Health Professions
Licensure and Certification of Other Practitioners of the Healing Arts

law.catch_line: When advanced practice registered nurse signature accepted
law.text: Whenever any law or regulation requires a signature, certification, stamp, verification, affidavit or endorsement by a physician, it shall be deemed to include a signature, certification, stamp, verification, affidavit or endorsement by an advanced practice registered nurse.
